newsitem.title: UK: UK Court case against Regan adjourned to Aug 21.
newsitem.headline: UK Court case against Regan adjourned to Aug 21.

text.p: A British court has adjourned a hearing of the case against entrepreneur Andrew Regan, originally brought as a private prosecutions by the Co-operative Wholesale Society (CWS), from Thursday until August 21, a CWS spokeswoman said.
The case has been taken over by the Crown Prosecution Service since it was launched as a private prosecution and the adjournment will allow police to investigate further, the spokeswoman said.
The supermarkets-to-funeral parlours group brought the case against Regan, his business partner David Lyons and former employee Allan Green after an abortive 1.2 billion stg bid attempt for the CWS.
Regan and Lyons have said they intend defending the case vigorously.
The CWS spokeswoman said that in August, if the police felt there was enough evidence, the case might proceed or alternatively be adjourned further.
